user.title: Mega Backup
user.description: Store Home Assistant backups in your Mega.io account. Backups are uploaded into one folder in the root of your cloud drive. The folder is created if it does not exist.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of your Mega account.
data_description.password: The password of your Mega account.
data_description.folder: Name of the folder for the backups (one level, no slashes).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Mega
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {email} failed. Please enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Mega. Please try again later.
error.invalid_folder: The folder name is empty or contains characters Mega does not allow (" * / : < > ? \ |).
error.mfa_required: This account uses two-factor authentication, which is not supported yet. Disable it for the account to use this integration.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Mega account is already configured.
